type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

record exponent divisibility obstruction to universal modular lowering

fix hygiene false positive in descent documentation

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Material.inhabited_forbids_global_nat_descent
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Nonempty α] (T : α → α) (μ : α → Nat) : ¬ (∀ s, μ (T s) < μ s)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Material.no_global_nat_descent
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (T : α → α) (μ : α → Nat) (hdec : ∀ s, μ (T s) < μ s) : IsEmpty α

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Material.stateIter_measure_strict
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (T : α → α) (μ : α → Nat) (hdec : ∀ s, μ (T s) < μ s) (n : Nat) (s : α) : μ (stateIter T (n + 1) s) < μ (stateIter T n s)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Material.stateIter_succ
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (T : α → α) (n : Nat) (s : α) : stateIter T (n + 1) s = T (stateIter T n s)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Material.stateIter_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (T : α → α) (s : α) : stateIter T 0 s = s

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.commonExponentPrime_dvd_weighted
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p x y z va vb vc : Nat) (hx : p ∣ x) (hy : p ∣ y) (hz : p ∣ z) : p ∣ 2 * x * va ∧ p ∣ 2 * y * vb ∧ p ∣ 2 * z * vc

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.powerSum_balance_int
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (d : BealData) : (d.a ^ d.x : Int) + ((d.b ^ d.y : Int) - (d.c ^ d.z : Int)) = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.powerSum_signed_ratio_numerator_int
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (d : BealData) : (d.b ^ d.y : Int) - (d.c ^ d.z : Int) = -(d.a ^ d.x : Int)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.productExponentPrime_not_universal
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∃ p x y z : Nat, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2 < x ∧ 2 < y ∧ 2 < z ∧ p ∣ x * y * z ∧ ¬ (p ∣ x ∧ p ∣ y ∧ p ∣ z)
